name: SnapDock
summary: A frosted glass dock, Windows-style snap layouts and one-click screenshots for Omarchy.
description:
SnapDock makes Omarchy feel instantly familiar, whether you're coming from Windows or macOS.

A DOCK MADE OF GLASS
A frosted dock sits at the bottom of your screen. It follows your theme automatically, or pick any colour and choose exactly how see-through it is. Pin the apps you love, unpin the ones you don't.

SNAP LIKE WINDOWS
Halves, quarters, thirds, two-thirds, fill or centre — arrange any window in one keystroke. Snapped windows resize from every edge.

TITLE BARS THAT WORK FOR YOU
Snap ⊞, maximize □ and close ✕, right where you expect them. Double-click a title bar to maximize.

SCREENSHOTS IN ONE CLICK
Tap the camera on the dock or press Shift + Print. The whole screen is copied to your clipboard and saved in Pictures.

LIFETIME UPDATES FOR EARLY ADOPTERS
Get SnapDock now and every future update is yours at no cost — forever. Updates appear in the Omarchy Store's Updates tab and install in one click.

REMOVES CLEANLY
Uninstall from inside SnapDock and every setting goes back exactly the way it was.

steps.title: Get it
steps.body: Press GET. The store downloads SnapDock, checks it's the genuine file, then a terminal asks for your password to install it.

steps.title: Open SnapDock
steps.body: Press Super + Space, type SnapDock, press Enter. The first launch sets up your dock and shortcuts.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.body: Choose the dock's colour and glass, pin your favourite apps, and turn features on or off.

faq.a: Yes — and everyone who installs it during launch is an early adopter: you get lifetime updates at no cost, even if SnapDock becomes a paid app later.

faq.q: Will it mess up my setup?
faq.a: SnapDock replaces your current dock and changes your Hyprland window settings the first time you open it. If you already set up your own dock (nwg-dock) or title bars, SnapDock takes over from them. It backs up every file it changes, and Uninstall puts them back, but it's smart to make your own copy first: cp -r ~/.config/hypr ~/.config/hypr.backup

faq.q: Does it work with my theme?
faq.a: Yes. The dock and title bars recolour themselves whenever you switch Omarchy themes.
Open the Omarchy Store and go to Updates. When a new SnapDock is out, press UPDATE — or Update All. SnapDock also tells you when a new version is ready.
Open SnapDock and choose Uninstall, then remove it from the store.

heads_up.title: Heads up: SnapDock replaces your current dock
heads_up.body: The first time you open it, SnapDock swaps out your existing dock and adjusts your Hyprland window settings (title bars, snapping, shortcuts). It backs up everything it changes and Uninstall restores it. If you've customized your dock or title bars, copy ~/.config/hypr somewhere safe first.
